name: Custom Shape Acrylic Block With Acrylic Pieces
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from premium clear acrylic, offering a glass-like appearance with excellent durability.
    - The design features a 2-layer structure that creates a dimensional decorative display:
                   +) Layer 1: Solid acrylic block – 15 mm thickness.
                   +) Layer 2: Decorative acrylic pieces – 3 mm thickness.
    - Smooth, polished edges provide a clean finish and safe handling.
    - The sturdy base allows the piece to stand securely on desks, shelves, or display surfaces.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
                   +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm.
                   +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm.
                   +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
    - The acrylic pieces can include up to 10 individual elements, each with a minimum size of 1 cm, creating a beautiful layered visual effect.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Produced using advanced UV printing technology to achieve vibrant colors and high-definition details.
    - Layer 1 (acrylic block): supports 1-sided or 2-sided printing.
    - Layer 2 (acrylic pieces): 1-sided printing for clear and precise decorative elements.
    - The UV printing process ensures long-lasting color quality, fade resistance, and a durable surface finish.
    - Transparent acrylic enhances the design by adding depth and brightness to the artwork.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - A freestanding decorative acrylic block designed for display on desks, shelves, nightstands, or cabinets.
    - The combination of a solid acrylic base and layered acrylic pieces creates a unique 3D visual effect.
    - Perfect for decorating homes, offices, or personal spaces with a meaningful decorative piece.
    - Adds an elegant and personalized touch to living rooms, workspaces, or memory displays.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful keepsake for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Suitable for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, memorial gifts, or housewarming celebrations.
    - Ideal for those who appreciate personalized décor and meaningful display items.
    - Combines sentimental value, artistic design, and elegant presentation, making it a memorable gift for any special occasion🎁

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape Acrylic Block With Acrylic Pieces

 

PRODUCTION

  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
